india: Robu.in: search "0.96 inch OLED I2C SSD1306"
notes: One per half, soldered straight into the board on its own header pins. Check the pin order printed on the module: GND, VCC, SCL, SDA. Some modules swap GND and VCC.

spec: 3.7 V LiPo pouch 505080 (5 × 50 × 80 mm), about 2500 mAh (listed 3000 mAh), JST-PH 2.0 2-pin lead, with a protection board
notes: The controller has no over-discharge cut-off, so the cell needs a protection board: ask the seller, and add a DW01A module to a cell without one. Lies in a bay sunk into the case floor, under the outer and middle key columns, held with double-sided tape, its lead end towards the battery connector: 2.9 mm below assumed 2 mm underside parts at rest, 1.4 mm at full gasket travel and at least 15 mm from the controller's antenna end. The connector is about 40 mm from the cell's lead end, so a lead of 60 mm or more reaches it. Check the red wire lands on the PCB's + pad before plugging in. Flown to India in hand luggage, connectors taped.

spec: JST-PH 2-pin, side-entry through-hole (S2B-PH-K-S)
notes: Side entry so the battery lead runs flat under the PCB.

spec: AO3401A P-channel MOSFET, SOT-23 (Q101/Q102, Q201/Q202)
notes: Q1 carries the battery current so the 50 mA slide switch only drives its gate (source to the battery, drain to B+). Q2 switches the LEDs' supply from B+.

spec: 1 MΩ resistor, 1206 (R101/R201)
notes: Holds the MOSFET off between switch positions.

spec: AO3400A N-channel MOSFET, SOT-23 (Q103/Q203)
notes: P0.08 drives its gate; it pulls the LED switch's gate low to turn the LEDs on.
R2 holds the LED switch off; R3 holds its N-MOSFET off while the controller boots or sleeps.
